title: David and Nabal: Abigail's Intervention
description: David and his men had protected Nabal's shepherds in the wilderness, but when David asked for a reward during the sheep-shearing at Carmel, the wealthy and hard-hearted Nabal scornfully rejected him. In anger, David armed four hundred men for revenge. Nabal's wise wife Abigail heard about it and rode out with a large gift. She bowed before David and begged him to refrain from shedding blood, so that he would not be guilty of bloodshed when the Lord made him prince. David blessed her wisdom and turned back. When Abigail told Nabal about this the next morning, his heart became like stone, and ten days later the Lord struck him down so that he died. David then proposed to Abigail, who became his wife.
